title: feat(app-shell): fold the approver's decision band on a record under approval
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_

repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg2evNa1V3zxrQq3KX

Fixes #34361

Clause-②: yes (widening — new @object-ui/i18n en keys only; no metadata/schema accept set)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批人打开审批中的记录时，原来平铺的 7 个审批按钮收成一条审批条：前面一行状态「待你审批 · 第 N 步 · 步骤名 · 提交人 X」，只露出「通过」「拒绝」两个按钮，转签 / 退回修改 / 退回补充 / 回复（审批人兼提交人还有撤回、催办）都放进一个「更多」菜单。业务记录页和审批请求页是同一条。记录自己标题栏的按钮不动。
- 为什么改：裁决 A（6917968848）。客户反馈记录页上有「两层菜单」，分不清哪一排是自己要做的事。
- 风险与回滚：只改按钮摆放，谁能审批、每个按钮的显示条件、对话框和发出的请求都不变；越权管理员的折叠（琥珀色菜单）和只是提交人的查看者都不变。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：① `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/DeclaredActionsBar.tsx` 里 `decisionBand` 那段（决定哪些按钮留在外面、何时收进菜单）；② `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/approvalDecisionFold.ts`（按动作声明的 variant 判断，不按名字）；③ 两个调用点各加了一个 `foldDecisions`。
- 两分钟验证：以审批人身份打开一条审批中的业务记录（或它的审批请求页），应看到一行「待你审批 · 第 N 步 …」，右边只有「通过」「拒绝」和一个「⋯ 更多」，点开「更多」能看到转签、退回修改、退回补充、回复。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

Ruling A (6917968848), executed as the coordinator's plan (6936836041) lays it out.

- **`DeclaredActionsBar` gains a second fold, `foldDecisions`** (the approver fold). It applies to a viewer the server says can act (`viewer.can_act === true`) once more than two of the bar's actions are shown:
  - a status line names the task (「待你审批」 / "Awaiting your approval"), the step's number on the served route (`flow_route`), the step's label (`step_label`), and the submitter (`submitter_name`, or the existing "You submitted this" when `viewer.is_submitter` is true);
  - the actions whose declared `variant` is `primary` or `danger` stay buttons (today `approval_approve` and `approval_reject`); the split is read off metadata (`isLeadDecision`), never off a name list, so an action shipped as metadata alone lands in the menu;
  - every other permitted action goes into one neutral "More approval actions" menu (`DropdownMenu` plus `DeclaredActionButton asMenuItem`, the same mechanism the override fold uses). The trigger is a plain outline button: the amber shield stays the override path's mark;
  - phone: the status line on top, then one row with the two decisions at equal width (`flex-1`) and the menu trigger at its end.
- **Gates and dispatch unchanged.** Every folded action keeps its own `visible`, `disabled` and capability gates and its dialog, and sends the same request.
- **`onDrawnActionsChange` semantics unchanged.** Menu actions still count as drawn: a closed menu's actions report through the same visibility probe the override fold uses. The only internal change is that the drawn-set reporter now records a `false` verdict as a key too, so "every action has reported" can be read; the drawn list itself still holds `true` verdicts only.
- **Until every action has reported its `visible` verdict, the band folds**, so the usual case never paints a flat row first. With two or fewer shown, the rest stay buttons.
- **Disjoint from the admin override fold by construction**: that viewer's `can_act` is `false`. `foldOverrides`, `isOverrideOnlyViewer`, `data-approval-override-folded` and their tests are unchanged.
- **Both call sites** pass `foldDecisions`: the business record page (`RecordDetailView`, beside its existing `foldOverrides`) and the request page (`ApprovalDecisionPanel`).
- **Deviation from ruling A's wording — reply (`approval_comment`) stays in the band's menu on both pages, not in the approvals panel.** Ruling 6917968848 and the card body say 回复 moves to the approvals panel or the discussion. The complaint (two stacked bars, reply in the button row) is still fixed: reply leaves the button row. Seat repo:objectstack#3 accepted the deviation on this reason; a line on #34361 lets the maintainer ask for a panel entry later. Moving it into the `RecordApprovalsPanel` timeline is more than a modest change here:
  - on the synthesized record page the panel is a tab (`record:approvals`), or a right-column block whose placement depends on the page tier;
  - the bar cannot tell whether a mounted panel is actually on screen, so a panel entry plus a menu fallback can draw reply twice or not at all;
  - the panel has no action runtime of its own: it would need a second `ActionProvider` and the request definition just to run one declared action.
  
  In the menu, reply is reachable on every layout.
- **Recall for an approver who also submitted**: in the menu (allowed by the plan).
- **Waited-days hint: not added.** No threshold logic for it exists in `app-shell`. The only age logic is the console inbox's relative-time formatter plus an SLA due date that the record page's request row does not carry. So there was nothing to reuse, and inventing a threshold is out of scope.
- **New `@object-ui/i18n` keys (four), in every pack**: `approvalsInbox.awaitingYourDecision`, `approvalsInbox.stepNumber`, `approvalsInbox.submittedByName`, `approvalsInbox.moreDecisionActions`. en and zh-Hans are hand-written, zh-Hant is regenerated by `gen:zh-hant` (byte-identical to what was written), and the other packs are translated. Reused keys: `approvalsInbox.submittedByYou`, `common.more`, `common.actions`.

## Why

Ruling A: 「A 收成一条“待你审批”」 — the approver's decision actions stay in their own band above the page body, folded: a status line that names the step, 通过 and 拒绝 as the only buttons, the other decision actions in one menu; the record's header actions do not move; no protocol change.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/DeclaredActionsBar.approverFold-34361.test.tsx` (12 tests):
  - approver: status line, two buttons, every other lever in the menu, in declaration order;
  - phone layout: `flex-1` on the decisions, the trigger last in the row;
  - a menu lever dispatches exactly as its button would;
  - approver plus submitter: remind and recall are in the menu, and the line says "You submitted this";
  - an action declared with no variant lands in the menu, not as a button;
  - the submitter-only viewer is unchanged;
  - the override-only admin stays on the override fold;
  - a host without `foldDecisions` is unchanged;
  - with two or fewer shown, the levers stay buttons;
  - drawn-set reports: menu levers counted, hidden ones not, and an empty set on unmount;
  - the request page (`ApprovalDecisionPanel`, real bar) draws the same band, remind included because that page excludes nothing.
- New `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/approvalDecisionFold.test.ts` (7 tests).
- Updated `RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx`: the approver's reassign, send back and request info are read from the band's menu (the override fold set this precedent for the same file). The submitter, override and fail-closed cases are untouched.
- `DeclaredActionsBar.foldOverrides-25877.test.tsx` and `utils/approvalOverride.test.ts` are unchanged and green.

## Acceptance notes

- **Claim surface amendment 6938979625** (area o3-A, per L1-a 6938968708): the existing test `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.approvalDeclaredActions.test.tsx` is edited (assertion edits only: three approver pins read reassign / send back / request info from the band's menu).

- **Sticky band on scroll**: not in ruling A, so not done. The coordinator's plan (6936836041) asks for the maintainer's confirmation first.
- **Reply in the panel**: kept in the menu; reasons under What changes.
- **Waited-days hint**: not added, because no threshold logic exists to reuse.
- **Docs**: `ui/AGENTS.md` #2 asks for a matching `content/docs/frontend/` page. `content/docs/**` is outside this card's claimed file surface, and the bar has no SDUI node type and no page that documents its props today.
- **Hot files**: #34631 (#34588, request page) rewrites `ApprovalDecisionPanel.tsx`. `overlap-check` reports a textual conflict with that head in this file. This PR's change there is one prop (`foldDecisions`) on the bar's call site, so whichever lands second keeps that one prop.

## Verification
